items.quote:
A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
8  left that town
items.contrast: The place he departed from, Bethlehem, versus the place he later came to, Micah’s house.
items.reason: “That town” refers to Bethlehem in Judah. Micah’s house is introduced as where he arrived while traveling, not where he set out.
